title: Pork Ribs Italian Casserole
description: Tender pork ribs slow-cooked in a rich Italian-style casserole. An easy and satisfying meal.
instructions: Season the pork ribs with Italian seasoning and garlic powder.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork ribs until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the ribs to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour the velvety tomato sauce over the ribs.
Sprinkle the shredded American cheese over the top.
Bake for 25 minutes, then top with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
